boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Pepperdine University
boards.description: Late-open, under-21-safe food and dessert destinations in Malibu and the nearby Westlake Village area.

cards.title: Zinqué Malibu
cards.subtitle: 23841 Malibu Road, Malibu
cards.notes: Use the patio or indoor tables for a late meal; confirm kitchen timing when planning because food service ends before the listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Malibu Road restaurant with the latest verified local weekend closing time on this board.
cards.evidence_claim: Zinqué Malibu lists hours of 7am–11pm Sunday–Thursday and 7am–12am Friday–Saturday; its kitchen is listed until 10pm and 11pm respectively.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 7am–11pm Sun–Thu (kitchen to 10pm) and 7am–12am Fri–Sat (kitchen to 11pm).

cards.title: Café Habana Malibu
cards.subtitle: 3939 Cross Creek Road, Malibu
cards.notes: Plan this Cross Creek Road stop around the published day-by-day schedule, and check the restaurant directly if a holiday or special event changes service.
cards.short_summary: A Malibu restaurant whose official location page lists 1am closing Wednesday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Café Habana’s Malibu location lists hours until 10pm Sunday–Tuesday and until 1am Wednesday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 11am–10pm Sun–Tue and 11am–1am Wed–Sat.

cards.title: Moonshadows Malibu
cards.subtitle: 20356 Pacific Coast Highway, Malibu
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s published dinner window as the planning anchor, especially if arriving on a Friday or Saturday when service is listed later.
cards.short_summary: A Pacific Coast Highway dinner destination with verified 11pm Friday and Saturday service.
cards.evidence_claim: Moonshadows Malibu lists dinner from 4pm–10pm Sunday–Thursday and 4pm–11pm Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists dinner to 10pm Sun–Thu and to 11pm Fri–Sat.

cards.title: Geoffrey's Malibu
cards.subtitle: 27400 Pacific Coast Highway, Malibu
cards.notes: Make a dinner reservation or call ahead for the date you plan to visit; the official site separates weekday and weekend dinner hours.
cards.short_summary: A Malibu dinner room with an official 10pm Friday and Saturday closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Geoffrey's Malibu lists dinner 4pm–9pm Sunday–Thursday and 4pm–10pm Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists dinner to 9pm Sun–Thu and to 10pm Fri–Sat.

cards.title: Harvest Kitchen & Bar
cards.subtitle: Hyatt Regency Westlake, Westlake Village
cards.notes: Order from the restaurant rather than relying on bar service; the hotel lists a distinct late-night food window that runs later than standard dinner.
cards.short_summary: A hotel restaurant whose official dining page lists a dedicated late-night menu until 10:45pm.
cards.evidence_claim: Hyatt Regency Westlake lists Harvest Kitchen & Bar dinner until 11pm daily and a late-night menu from 10pm–10:45pm daily.
cards.access_notes: Official Hyatt page lists dinner 4pm–11pm daily and the late-night menu 10pm–10:45pm daily.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger Westlake Village
cards.subtitle: 30780 Russell Ranch Road, Westlake Village
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru or dine-in seating listed by the location page, and choose a weekday or weekend timing based on the published midnight schedule.
cards.short_summary: A nearby quick-service stop with verified midnight and 12:30am closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: The Westlake Village In-N-Out lists dine-in seating and drive-thru, open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 12:30am Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 10:30am–12am Sun–Thu and 10:30am–12:30am Fri–Sat.

cards.title: Yogurtland Westlake Village
cards.subtitle: 111 South Westlake Boulevard, Westlake Village
cards.notes: Choose this for a late dessert run, and call first on holidays because the location page flags that holiday hours may differ from the weekly schedule.
cards.short_summary: A self-serve frozen-yogurt option listed until midnight most nights and 1am Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Yogurtland’s Westlake Village location lists hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1am Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 11am–12am Sun–Thu and 11am–1am Fri–Sat; it advises calling on holidays.

cards.title: Chipotle Mexican Grill Westlake Village
cards.subtitle: 5754 Lindero Canyon Road, Westlake Village
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page for pickup or delivery details, and allow time to place the order before the daily 11pm store closing.
cards.short_summary: A nearby customizable-meal stop with official daily 11pm hours and pickup availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle’s Westlake Village location lists restaurant hours of 10:30am–11pm daily, with in-store pickup and delivery available.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours of 10:30am–11pm Monday–Sunday.

cards.title: Crawford's Social
cards.subtitle: 974 South Westlake Boulevard, Westlake Village
cards.notes: For a later meal, use the restaurant’s Friday or Saturday schedule and confirm seating arrangements directly before heading over from Malibu.
cards.short_summary: A Westlake Village restaurant listing midnight Friday and Saturday closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Crawford's Social lists hours until 10pm Sunday–Thursday and until midnight Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Mon–Thu and Sun to 10pm, with Friday and Saturday hours to 12am.

cards.entity_name: Patron Mexican Bar & Grill Westlake Village
cards.title: Patron Mexican Bar & Grill Westlake Village
cards.subtitle: 3709 East Thousand Oaks Boulevard, Westlake Village
cards.notes: Use the dining or takeout options named on the restaurant’s location page, with Friday or Saturday providing the latest listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Westlake Village restaurant whose official page lists 10pm Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Patron Mexican Bar & Grill’s Westlake Village location lists dine-in and takeout, open until 9pm Sunday–Thursday and 10pm Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Patron Mexican Bar & Grill — Westlake Village
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 8:30am–9pm Sun–Thu and 8:30am–10pm Fri–Sat.
